one_row: one original planned issue; no reindexing, replacement or extension
NA: literal NA for missing, unverifiable, conflicting or structurally inapplicable values; reasons in missing_reasons
sales: currency amount of completed draw total sales/turnover; never prize pool, jackpot or inferred from payout
ticket_price: full single-entry currency amount; documentary regime assignment for UK/JP, official per-draw unitBet for HK; not a physical-ticket count
ticket_price_basis: source keys in retrievals.json, not evidence of exhaustive rule continuity
prize_scheme: JSON: main pool, drawn-main count, tier conditions. Not an asserted complete legal payout contract.
full_prize_rule_version: NA unless complete dated applicable legal allocation/caps/promotion version chain verified; presently all NA
announcement_at_utc: verified original publication timestamp only; all NA. Draw/open/close/HTTP Last-Modified/Date/download time never substituted.
announcement_source_key: NA because no original official publication timestamp was verified
secondary_claimed_publication_date: MarkSixInfo self-reported datePublished date only; unverified original publication, not a UTC timestamp
publication_precision: unknown for original official publication; secondary date-only claim separately preserved
tier_k_winners: UK/JP counts of entries; HK full-unit equivalents winningUnit/unitBet per official browser; fractional values retained exactly, not unique persons
tier_k_payout: currency payout per winning full entry; NA if no winners, not 0 or offered jackpot. Not total prize fund.
tier_k_reported_prize: exact source quote, even for no-winner draw (0 or an unawarded jackpot); conflicts NA; raw original values in captures and crosschecks
primary_source_sha256: SHA256 of original HTTP entity content bytes after HTTP transfer decompression, before character decoding or normalization
primary_fetched_at_utc: acquisition completion timestamp, not original announcement time
crosscheck_source_keys: financial crosscheck sources; source URL/hash/time linked in retrievals.json; domains not proof of independent data generation
conflict_policy: adopted field NA even where primary is official; preserve official and backup original values; no majority vote or correction by plausibility
no_winner_quote_convention: offered jackpot/0/not-applicable differences when count explicitly0; not an actual payout contradiction; payout remains NA
uk_sales_check: Merseyworld only; Lottery.co.uk omits sales for all700; no claim that sales was independently checked
financial_na_definition: NA cells among sales, ticket_price, tier{k}_winners and tier{k}_payout; excludes duplicate reported-prize quote and metadata; includes no-winner structural NAs
currency: GBP, JPY, HKD; no FX conversion
use_policy: forensic data acceptance only, no model or prediction; sealed/existing discovery access module unchanged
